scope: Fresno County and boundary river planning with regional weather context; nine named wind forecast samples, no inferred continuous wind surface

sources.product: Wind speed, wind gust and wind direction forecast grids
sources.height: 10 meters above ground; direction is meteorological FROM relative to true north
sources.cadence: Publisher updates vary; scheduled Pages collection target 15 minutes, not guaranteed. Browser checks every 5 minutes while visible; old, unavailable or incomplete snapshots trigger a direct NWS check, reused in memory for up to 15 minutes.
sources.identity: Watchlist ID plus publisher office/grid X/Y, re-resolved each collection
sources.missing: Nulls, conflicting duplicates and gaps are unknown; no interpolation or extrapolation
sources.initial_verification: All nine points returned forecast series successfully; source grid identity, units, intervals and update times checked
sources.access: Public HTTPS, no credentials; only public forecast samples in deployment artifacts
sources.maintenance: FROG GIS app maintainer; county/NWS coordination required for operational thresholds

sources.product: GOES East/West observed infrared and water vapor imagery
sources.time_fields: Explicit time Dimension for each WMS Layer; UTC TIME sent on GetMap
sources.cadence: Five-minute frame spacing observed in capabilities; publisher times determine actual availability
sources.display: Publisher-rendered image and publisher legend; no inference of temperature, precipitation, visibility or surface humidity from image pixels
sources.timeline: Nearest earlier explicit image within tolerance; observations hidden for every future target time
sources.initial_verification: Both products and explicit frame timestamps present in live capabilities
sources.access: Public WMS accessed directly in browser, no token or imagery archive
sources.maintenance: FROG GIS app maintainer; official NOAA nowCOAST link retained for source outages

time_policy: One weather target time across radar, GOES, wind and WPC. WPC retains its entire accumulation window. Other operational feeds retain independent source times.
use: Planning context. No wind threshold, automatic activation, utility PSPS inference or dispatch action is configured.
